title: Railway header
description: A sticky, solid dark top bar: a bold wordmark on the left, a centred nav whose items light up with a soft surface on hover and drop down small menus, and two quiet ghost links on the right. Phones get a two-line menu button that opens a full-width list.
notes: dropdowns open on hover and keyboard focus (CSS only); the phone menu is a <details>, so no JavaScript is needed
